typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		BatchId as integer,
		DISENDTE as string,
		GRACEEXPDTE as string,
		PREMDUEDTE as string,
		PAYRECDTE as string,
		CURRDTE2 as string,
		LANGCD as string,
		OUTFIND as string,
		PLANNAME as string,
		MARKETSEG as string,
		SYSTEM as string,
		TCPULLIND as string,
		TCACTIONIND as string,
		TCFILEIND as string,
		PREMDUE as string,
		PREVPAYAMT as string,
		SHORTAMT as string,
		NSFAMT as string,
		NSFFEE as string,
		TOTAMT as string,
		SUBFSTNME as string,
		SUBMIDINIT as string,
		SUBLSTNME as string,
		SUBADDRCAREOF as string,
		SUBADDRSTREET as string,
		SUBADDRCITY as string,
		SUBADDRST as string,
		SUBADDRZIP5 as string,
		SUBADDRZIP4 as string,
		DEPFSTNME as string,
		DEPMIDINIT as string,
		DEPLSTNME as string,
		BILLDATEFROM as string,
		BILLDATETO as string,
		INVOICENBR as string,
		MEMBERID as string,
		DEPENDENTID as string,
		GROUPNAME as string,
		GROUPBILLINGENTITY as string,
		GROUPID as string,
		PLANID as string,
		CLASSID as string,
		LEGALENTITY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT * FROM INVOICE.TC_LETTERDETAIL WHERE BATCHID=? AND OUTFIND LIKE \'15NOT%\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of TCFILEIND} = toString(TCFILEIND),
		{Copy of CURRDTE2} = toString(CURRDTE2),
		{Copy of DEPFSTNME} = toString(DEPFSTNME),
		{Copy of MEMBERID} = toString(MEMBERID),
		{Copy of CLASSID} = toString(CLASSID),
		{Copy of SUBADDRSTREET} = toString(SUBADDRSTREET),
		{Copy of BILLDATETO} = toString(BILLDATETO),
		{Copy of SUBADDRZIP5} = toString(SUBADDRZIP5),
		{Copy of GRACEEXPDTE} = toString(GRACEEXPDTE),
		{Copy of SUBADDRCITY} = toString(SUBADDRCITY),
		{Copy of SYSTEM} = toString(SYSTEM),
		{Copy of PREMDUEDTE} = toString(PREMDUEDTE),
		{Copy of GROUPID} = toString(GROUPID),
		{Copy of SHORTAMT} = toString(SHORTAMT),
		{Copy of TCACTIONIND} = toString(TCACTIONIND),
		{Copy of SUBADDRCAREOF} = toString(SUBADDRCAREOF),
		{Copy of PAYRECDTE} = toString(PAYRECDTE),
		{Copy of DEPMIDINIT} = toString(DEPMIDINIT),
		{Copy of OUTFIND} = toString(OUTFIND),
		{Copy of PREMDUE} = toString(PREMDUE),
		{Copy of DEPLSTNME} = toString(DEPLSTNME),
		{Copy of DISENDTE} = toString(DISENDTE),
		{Copy of GROUPNAME} = toString(GROUPNAME),
		{Copy of TCPULLIND} = toString(TCPULLIND),
		{Copy of BILLDATEFROM} = toString(BILLDATEFROM),
		{Copy of INVOICENBR} = toString(INVOICENBR),
		{Copy of SUBLSTNME} = toString(SUBLSTNME),
		{Copy of PLANID} = toString(PLANID),
		{Copy of DEPENDENTID} = toString(DEPENDENTID),
		{Copy of SUBADDRZIP4} = toString(SUBADDRZIP4),
		{Copy of PREVPAYAMT} = toString(PREVPAYAMT),
		{Copy of TOTAMT} = toString(TOTAMT),
		{Copy of NSFFEE} = toString(NSFFEE),
		{Copy of LEGALENTITY} = toString(LEGALENTITY),
		{Copy of SUBFSTNME} = toString(SUBFSTNME),
		{Copy of SUBADDRST} = toString(SUBADDRST),
		{Copy of SUBMIDINIT} = toString(SUBMIDINIT),
		{Copy of NSFAMT} = toString(NSFAMT),
		{Copy of PLANNAME} = toString(PLANNAME),
		{Copy of LANGCD} = toString(LANGCD),
		{Copy of MARKETSEG} = toString(MARKETSEG),
		{Copy of GROUPBILLINGENTITY} = toString(GROUPBILLINGENTITY)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
